shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger + auto-launch. A full plunge doesn't just ride over the top — the ball wraps around the fishing-reel spinner like line on a reel, then drops out beside the tiny right mini flipper and its pop bumper. Skill shot levels 1-3 are chosen by pull strength.

shots.name: Pop Bumper
shots.notes: Single pop bumper; Level 1 skill shot target. Buoy plastic on Pro, sculpted Orca barrel on Premium/LE.

shots.name: Mini-Flipper Lane
shots.notes: Right-side vertical lane feeding the mini flipper; lights Quickshot; Level 2 skill shot.

shots.name: Mid-Right Mini Flipper
shots.notes: Shoots across to the harpoon lane, left 3-bank and left orbit. Home of Flip-Lock: action button holds a cradled ball ~20s during multiball.

shots.name: Harpoon Lane
shots.notes: Far-left lane (Quickshot 1X/2X/4X by depth); shot from the mini flipper or via the left orbit when the harpoon gate is open. Yellow = load barrel, blue = Quickshot.

shots.name: Left 3-Bank (Fish Finder)
shots.notes: Standups on Pro, drop targets with roving-arrow qualify on Premium/LE. Lights machete, Fish Finder awards, Pipit, Ready Barrel.

shots.name: Left Orbit (West Beach)
shots.notes: Night Swim beach shot; spinner in the mouth advances Bounty. Harpoon gate can divert it into the harpoon lane; otherwise wraps to the mini-flipper side.

shots.name: Wave Ramp (Marina)
shots.notes: Left ramp; strong shots spell O-R-C-A. Pro: wireform returns to the mini flipper; Premium/LE: feeds the Orca upper playfield. Beach Panic start shot.

shots.name: Chum Bucket
shots.notes: Kinetic Chum Bucket Newton ball between the ramps; feeds the chum line toward Jaws Multiball; add-a-ball source; super-secret skill shot family.

shots.name: Center Ramp (North Beach)
shots.notes: Half-pipe ramp returning to the left inlane. Scars start shot; where most mini-wizards and the final wizard start.

shots.name: Captive Ball / Bash Boat
shots.notes: Multi-directional captive ball with 3 optos in front of the shark cage (Pro) / Ben Gardner's boat (Prem/LE). Lights encounters, banks boosts, bounty damage, super jackpots.

shots.name: Great White Bash Shark
shots.notes: Motorized shark that crashes up through Ben Gardner's boat when encounters/bounty bashes are live; Pro uses the captive ball for all shark shots.

shots.name: Shark Fin Drop Target
shots.notes: Motorized fin roving a 7-position arc mid-playfield. Barrel attach, Quickshot collect, encounter jackpots, super jackpots. Dangerous ricochets — Shark Cage gear insures it.

shots.name: Fishing Reel (The Pond)
shots.notes: Right-side lane over a horizontal spinner disc; Pond Attack start and Bounty Hunt start/advance. Hardest shot on the game.

shots.name: Right Ramp (East Beach / Quint's Shack)
shots.notes: Tight ramp to Quint's Shack; wireform to the right inlane. Gear collect/cash-out, Bounty Hunt light, Raft Attack start.

shots.name: Shark Tower Targets
shots.notes: Three yellow standups flanking the beach shots (x≈0.24, 0.66, 0.81). Light beachgoers and Feeding Frenzy; lower Scars values — brush, don't bash, during Scars.

shots.name: Life Ring Target
shots.notes: Buoy standup below the pop bumper; two hits arm the Life Ring left-outlane save; Super Life Ring award target.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Machete arming lane; up-post at its top stages balls for Quickshots. Fed by center ramp and left orbit.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Fed by the right ramp wireform; Quint's Challenge lights here after O-R-C-A; machete can light here too.

shots.name: Action Button
shots.notes: Lockdown-bar button (below the flipper line): Life Ring outlane save when flashing, and Flip-Lock hold on the mini flipper.

shots.name: Lookout Tower Ramp
shots.notes: Small circular ramp on the Orca upper playfield with reverse-180 wireform; 8 shots = extra ball; Quint combo into the right ramp; 5x Raft Attack combo leg.

shots.name: Ship's Wheel Spinner
shots.notes: Horizontal spinner disc styled as the ship's wheel on the Orca deck. Hitting it from the deck flipper sets the wheel spinning like a game-show prize wheel and pays points while it spins — keep it ripping for value. Premium/LE only.

shots.name: Radio Target
shots.notes: Orca-deck standup; hitting it spots a mode shot once per mode.

shots.name: Orca Deck Flipper
shots.notes: The upper deck's own small flipper (position estimated from gameplay video — vision pass refines it). Deck shots are made from here, same one-shot-per-flipper flow as the main playfield.

goals.title: Skill Shot — Level 1: Light Plunge
goals.summary: The first skill shot on offer: a light plunge that drops the ball into the pop bumpers just off the shooter lane. Collecting it moves the ladder up to Level 2 for your next ball.
goals.reward: 5M + 5s ball save

steps.action: Light plunge into the pop bumpers
steps.detail: An easy pull — the ball only needs to climb partway up the lane and fall into the pops. 5M and 5 more seconds of ball save.

goals.title: Skill Shot — Level 2: Short Plunge
goals.summary: A short plunge that reaches the mini flipper clean — the pop bumper next door voids it. Level 1 is the rung below this one.
goals.reward: 10M + Gear + 5s ball save
goals.requiresNote: The ladder steps up at the start of your next ball, not mid-ball — and banking the rung isn't the only way up: the Super Secret Skill Shot also advances the ladder.

steps.action: Short plunge into the mini-flipper lane
steps.detail: Ease the plunger so the ball rolls down to the tiny right mini flipper WITHOUT touching the pop bumper on the way — 10M, lights Gear, and 5 more seconds of ball save.

goals.title: Skill Shot — Level 3: Plunge Through
goals.summary: Full plunge clean through to the flippers, then make the lit fish-finder target from the right flipper — nothing else touched on the way. Level 2 is the rung below this one.
goals.reward: 15M + Gear + 5s ball save
goals.requiresNote: The ladder steps up at the start of your next ball, not mid-ball — and banking the rung isn't the only way up: the Super Secret Skill Shot also advances the ladder.

steps.action: Full plunge through to the flippers
steps.detail: The ball has to reach the flippers clean — touching any other switch on the way down voids the level.

steps.detail: Catch or play the ball off the right flipper and make the lit left 3-bank target first shot. 15M and lights Gear.

goals.reward: Base 2x next shot; permanent +1x per Shark Encounter completed, per Night Search Multiball completed, and per bounty shark captured on the first attempt — Mako's bonus lights Gear instead, and post-4th-of-July Encounter Challenges hand out a permanent shot multiplier rather than machete.

steps.detail: Hardest and most drain-prone shot on the game — start it with a ball save or a life ring armed

steps.action: Collect the Encounter Jackpot at the fin every time
steps.detail: Missing the fin cuts the jackpot to a fraction of the mode total; cash a machete on the big ones

goals.title: Capture Every Bounty Hunt
goals.summary: Bounty Hunts are separate small multiballs, one per shark on the board, each qualified by spinner rips and mode chores and each ending on a capture shot at the fishing reel. Take the easiest one first — its perk speeds up every hunt after it — and finish with the six-ball Great White, which unlocks by selling gear to Quint.
goals.reward: A capture perk per shark, escalating bounty collects, and the six-ball Great White hunt

steps.action: Take "Light Bounty Hunt" from Quint's Shack whenever it is offered
steps.detail: Always the correct shack award if no hunt is lit

steps.action: Rip the fishing reel to advance the bounty
steps.detail: The Dart perk doubles bounty advance; the Mako perk doubles reel spins

steps.action: Finish the qualify chores and start the hunt at the reel
steps.detail: Two-ball multiball with a short ball save; green shots reel the shark in

steps.action: Bash the shark when it is lit to drop its health
steps.detail: Prem/LE: the motorized shark crashes up through the boat for these hits

steps.action: Land the capture shot at 1% health
steps.detail: Fail and the shark returns later needing half the shots. You still earn its capture perk, but the bonus reward is forfeited and the bounty multiplier drops for the revisit

steps.action: Sell your gear to Quint to qualify the Great White
steps.detail: The big cash-out doubles as the unlock for the final six-ball hunt

steps.action: Use Flip-Lock during each hunt
steps.detail: Hold a ball on the mini flipper with the action button so you can aim the reel with one ball loose

goals.title: Attract-Mode Challenge Menu
goals.summary: JAWS keeps a second menu of ways to play behind its attract screen, and most players never learn it is there. Holding both flipper buttons while the machine sits idle brings up a list of alternate games built on the same code, including one that drops the pinball entirely and runs only the game's hidden video game.
instructions: Hold both flipper buttons while the machine sits in attract mode with no game in progress
Keep holding until the mode menu appears on the display
Choose the mode you want, then start your game
Standard is the normal ruleset; Competition is the same game with random elements removed
Shark Hunter plays the hidden video game on its own, paid for with shark teeth through a Stern Insider account
4th of July Challenge, Jaws: The Revenge, and The Shark Is Broken are separate standalone challenges on the same menu
goals.reward: Access to Competition, a standalone Shark Hunter video-game session, and the 4th of July Challenge, Jaws: The Revenge, and The Shark Is Broken challenge modes

goals.title: Video Mode: Shark Hunter
goals.summary: One of the five Fish Finder awards is not points at all — it arms a genuine video game, and the right ramp is the shot that launches it. Once it starts the flippers stop flipping and start firing harpoons at sharks, while divers swim through the same water and cost you a shot if you hit one.
instructions: Work the left 3-bank through the Fish Finder award cycle until Light Video Mode (Shark Hunter) is awarded
Shoot the right ramp to launch Shark Hunter
Use the flipper buttons to fire harpoons at the sharks on screen
Avoid the divers — hitting one removes a harpoon shot instead of scoring
Watch for the quick-moving extra ball icon and shoot it if you can
goals.reward: 3,000 points for every point scored inside the video game, so a 5,000-point run pays 15 million. This award cannot be multiplied by Machete. A fast-moving extra ball icon also appears inside the video game and can be shot for an extra ball.

goals.title: The Six Pieces of Gear and What Each One Buys You
goals.summary: Gear is the closest thing this machine has to an inventory. Six different pieces exist, you get to pick which one you take before you take it, and each bends a different part of the game your way for a limited run of use. Every piece you leave unspent is worth more when you finally sell the whole set.
instructions: Light gear at the right ramp — level 2 and level 3 skill shots light it, and so do quickshots
Before you shoot the right ramp, cycle with the right flipper to the piece you actually want; the ramp collects whichever one is flashing
Barrel hook: when your Jaws Multiball falls back to a single ball, another ball is launched and the multiball keeps running
Shark cage: a ball save tied to the fin drop target, good for one save
Dart: your next bounty hunt advances faster and the bounty it pays is worth more
Binoculars: beachgoers become easier to collect
Oxygen tank: ball save timers and mode timers all run longer
Tracker: the chum line that builds toward Jaws Multiball advances faster
With all six types collected, one more right ramp shot offers the sale to Quint — the payout climbs with every piece you left unspent, and the sale qualifies the final bounty hunt
goals.reward: Six perks chosen one at a time; a full set sold to Quint pays a large score and qualifies the final bounty hunt for the great white

goals.title: Pick Your Shark: The Bounty Hunt Upgrade Ladder
goals.summary: Bounty hunts are this machine's upgrade tree. Work the fishing reel and the right ramp to light one, choose which shark you want to go after, and every shark you land hands over a perk that stays with you for the rest of the game.
instructions: Spin the fishing reel and work the right ramp until start bounty hunt lights at the right ramp
Choose which shark to chase — mako, thresher, hammerhead or tiger. The mako's list of tasks is the lightest, so it is the usual place to start
The display shows that shark's set of shots; clear them during single-ball play, because progress toward them switches off while a multiball is running
With the list cleared, shoot the fishing reel to start the bounty hunt multiball and begin reeling the shark in
Take a green shot to light the shark, then hit the captive-ball shark to wear it down, and repeat
Once it is worn down, the reel lights as the final shot — take the reel, then the shark, to land it
Landing the mako upgrades the fishing reel: it advances twice as fast toward every hunt that follows
Landing the tiger removes the once-per-ball limit on flip-lock, the mini-flipper hold that parks a ball during multiball, and relights it after five shots instead
Selling a full set of gear to Quint qualifies the fifth and final hunt, for the great white
goals.reward: A lasting perk for each shark landed — the mako doubles reel progress toward later hunts, the tiger removes the once-per-ball limit on flip-lock

goals.title: Shark Teeth and the Progress That Outlives the Game
goals.summary: Signed in, JAWS keeps a second record that has nothing to do with the score on the display. Achievements you earn are filed against your account, every achievement point also pays you shark teeth, and those teeth are the currency that opens the challenge modes hiding behind the attract screen.
instructions: Scan into a Stern Insider Connected account before the game starts — the reader sits on the bottom arch, and none of this is kept without it

Achievements cover both one-game feats and running lifetime totals: capturing bounty sharks, completing each shark encounter, landing the secret skill shots, and bronze, silver and gold tiers for counts like beachgoers collected, beaches closed and balls saved with the life ring
Every achievement point you earn also pays out shark teeth
Teeth stack up into whole jaws — the display only breaks in to announce a finished jaw, and the end-of-ball summary shows both teeth and jaw progress

Teeth are what you spend on the challenge modes behind the attract-mode menu: Shark Hunter on its own, the 4th of July Challenge, Jaws: The Revenge and The Shark Is Broken, each needing you signed in with enough teeth banked
The Shark Is Broken also needs the topper fitted to the machine, so a full tooth bank alone will not open it

Jaws: The Revenge is where a character actually levels: eat swimmers to fill the shark's growth meter and it climbs from mako to thresher to hammerhead to tiger to great white, each step cutting the number of bites a swimmer costs you

Your Bounty Hunter rank is a lifetime figure that keeps climbing across every signed-in game instead of resetting with the score, and the same account carries JAWS Quests — set challenges that pay a badge when you finish one
Play without signing in and the teeth, the achievements and the rank all go unrecorded
goals.reward: A bank of shark teeth that buys the challenge modes, plus an achievement record and a Bounty Hunter rank that keep building across every game you play signed in

goals.title: Lookout Tower: The Repeatable Deck Loop
goals.summary: Premium/LE only: the small ramp on the Orca deck is a return trip, not a one-shot — eight of them across a game bank an extra ball, and catching the exit straight into the right ramp completes the Quint combo.
goals.reward: 8 lifetime lookout tower shots = extra ball; lookout tower into right ramp = Quint combo; also the 5x leg of the Raft Attack fin combo

steps.action: Get onto the deck with a full-strength Wave-ramp shot
steps.detail: Premium/LE only

steps.action: Loop the small ramp on the deck
steps.detail: Reverse-180 wireform sends it back down — every make counts toward the 8-shot extra ball for the rest of the game

steps.action: Catch the return and go straight into the right ramp for the Quint combo
steps.detail: Has to be immediate off the exit; this same chain is also the 5x multiplier leg during Raft Attack

achievements.title: Barrel On The Line
achievements.desc: Attach your first barrel at the Shark Fin and start the first Jaws Multiball.

achievements.title: Name The Boat
achievements.desc: Spell O-R-C-A with full-strength Wave ramp shots and collect the Quint's Shack award at the right ramp.

achievements.title: Thrown A Line
achievements.desc: Arm the Life Ring at its standup target, then save a left-outlane drain with the action button.

achievements.title: Double Or Nothing
achievements.desc: Bank Encounter Boost Level 3 off extra boat hits so a full Shark Encounter runs at doubled scoring.

achievements.title: Three Rungs Up
achievements.desc: Work the leveled skill shot all the way to Level 3 in a single game.

achievements.title: Harpoon Payday
achievements.desc: Collect three Quickshots in one game to earn the extra ball.

achievements.title: First Blood Answered
achievements.desc: Complete a Shark Encounter through all three phases and collect its Encounter Jackpot at the fin.

achievements.title: Sweep The Sonar
achievements.desc: Collect all five Fish Finder awards to light Super Cast 'N Catch.

achievements.title: Searchlights Out
achievements.desc: Complete Night Search Multiball for the permanent base machete increase.

achievements.title: First Catch Tagged
achievements.desc: Capture the Mako in its Bounty Hunt multiball and keep the capture perk.

achievements.title: Dead Center Off The Plunge
achievements.desc: Land the Super Secret skill shot by hitting the captive ball dead-center straight off the plunge.

achievements.title: Run It Down
achievements.desc: Reach and collect a Super Jackpot at the captive ball during the second barrel multiball.

achievements.title: Down In The Cage
achievements.desc: Attach a third barrel, play the Cage Dive multiball, and complete it.

achievements.title: Sell The Whole Kit
achievements.desc: Collect all six pieces of gear without spending any perk, then sell the lot to Quint at the top multiplier.

achievements.title: Twenty-Five Fireworks
achievements.desc: Reach 25 fireworks in the 4th of July mini-wizard and cash the Super Jackpot at the boat.

achievements.title: All Five Beaches Answered
achievements.desc: Complete every one of the five Shark Encounters in a single game.

achievements.title: Last Word On The Mast
achievements.desc: Beat all three phases of the final wizard mode and roll into Super Celebration Multiball.

achievements.title: Whole Bounty Board
achievements.desc: Capture every Bounty Hunt shark in one game, finishing with the six-ball Great White hunt.

drills.title: Skill Shot Ladder
drills.text: Run all three plunge levels back to back, then try both secrets. Feel for exactly how much plunger pull dies in the lane above the mini flipper versus how much carries on into the pops — the gap between Level 1 and Level 2 is smaller than it looks.

drills.title: Quickshot Farm Reps
drills.text: From a trapped ball on the mini flipper, rip the harpoon lane, then snap over to the fin the instant it's live. Chain as many makes as you can before a miss resets the multiplier back to 1x.

drills.title: Fishing Reel: Trap and Flip
drills.text: Trap the ball dead on the left flipper, then flip the instant it overlaps the left edge of the Jaws graphic between the flippers. This is the hardest shot on the machine for a reason — most of the work is the trap, not the flip.

drills.title: Boost, Bank, Start
drills.text: Single-ball only: bash the boat to Boost Level 3, then start Scars and play it clean through the fin with no multiball to hide behind. Every shot has to count.

drills.title: Orca Deck Access (Premium/LE)
drills.text: Full-strength Wave-ramp shots only — anything soft just returns to the mini flipper without reaching the deck. Once you're up there, spin the wheel, then catch the ball as it feeds back down to the mini flipper instead of panic-flipping it away blind.

drills.title: Beach-Closing Loop
drills.text: Hit a shark tower target, then immediately go collect the beachgoer it lit instead of wandering off to something else. Three on the same beach banks the hurry-up plus a scoring boost that lasts the rest of the game.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: One button, two very different jobs. Armed, it throws out the Life Ring to rescue a left-outlane drain; during any multiball it freezes the mini flipper up so you can park a ball out of play. Premium and LE owners get a third job: locking in the Orca wheel award.

uses.when: Ball rolling into the left outlane
uses.what: Fires the Life Ring save, but only while the insert glows orange — the window is short and shrinks with every use.

uses.when: Ball cradled on the mini flipper
uses.what: A tap keeps that flipper raised, so a two-ball multiball plays like single-ball with a spare banked.

uses.when: Ready to release a parked ball
uses.what: Hold instead of tapping and the mini flipper drops the ball back into play on your terms.

uses.when: Lining up the fishing reel shot
uses.what: Bank one ball on the mini flipper first so only one ball is loose while you aim.
Press when the pointer sits on the award you want — Shark Ramps and the rest lock in on that press.

howItPlays.objective: Survive the summer on Amity Island by hunting the Great White. Complete shark encounters, attach barrels, capture bounty sharks, and blow up the shark in the final wizard.
loop: Hit the bash boat to light a Shark Encounter, then shoot its beach shot to start the mode.
Feed the chum line with red-arrow shots to raise the fin, then bash the fin to attach a barrel and start Jaws Multiball.
Complete the left 3-bank and roll a lit inlane to arm the machete, then spend it on a high-value shot.
Spin the fishing reel to light Bounty Hunts, complete tasks, and capture sharks for permanent perks.

lights.name: Machete Arm Lanes
lights.lit: A lit inlane arms the machete multiplier for your next shot.
lights.then: Shoot a high-value target like the captive ball or a mode jackpot.

lights.name: Quickshot Lanes
lights.lit: Rolling the mini-flipper lane lights the harpoon lane blue; a harpoon shot followed quickly by the fin collects a Quickshot.
lights.then: Hit the fin immediately after the harpoon lane.

lights.name: Chum Line & Barrel Arrows
lights.lit: Red arrows mark shots that fill the chum line; yellow flashing shots raise the fin to attach a barrel.
lights.flashing: Yellow flashing shots raise the fin; red flashing shots are jackpots during multiball.
lights.then: Bash the raised fin to start a Jaws Multiball.

lights.name: Encounter Start Shots
lights.lit: A lit beach shot starts its Shark Encounter; hit the bash boat first to light one.
lights.then: Shoot the lit beach shot to begin the mode.

lights.name: O-R-C-A Letters
lights.lit: Strong wave-ramp shots spell O-R-C-A; completing it lights a Quint's Shack award at the right ramp.
lights.then: Shoot the right ramp to collect the award.

lights.name: Fish Finder Awards
lights.lit: Each hit on the left 3-bank advances the Fish Finder award; completing all five lights Super Cast 'N Catch.
lights.then: Shoot the bank to collect the lit award.

lights.name: Lookout Tower Extra Ball
lights.lit: Eight shots to the Lookout Tower ramp light an extra ball (Premium/LE only).
lights.then: Shoot the ramp to collect the extra ball.

scoring.text: Take the skill shot ladder (light plunge, short plunge, or full plunge to the lit 3-bank) for quick points. Then hit the bash boat to light a Shark Encounter and start it at its beach shot.
Build the machete multiplier by completing the left 3-bank and rolling lit inlanes, then stack Jaws Multiball with a Shark Encounter. Bank encounter boosts at the boat for 2x mode scoring.
Complete all three barrel multiballs (Reel Him In!, The Chase, Cage Dive) to qualify the final wizard 'Smile, You Son of a…', a three-phase battle ending in Super Celebration Multiball.
